meaning_hint: Short for promotion: a short advert or video.
examples: We watched the promo for the new show.
The store is running a summer promo.

I saw the promo on TV last night.
The tabloid printed rumors about the singer.
He reads a tabloid on the train.
Tabloids love stories about famous couples.

meaning_hint: Standard Ukrainian is комендант; командант is a regional/historical form.
examples: The commandant gave the order to march.

Plug the USB cable into the computer.

meaning_hint: Listed 'oxid' is an old variant spelling of oxide.
examples: Iron oxide is the red color of rust.

The guitarist played a long solo.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian somewhat dated/ironic: a date, a meeting.

meaning_hint: райх is a less common spelling; usual form рейх.
examples: The Third Reich ended in 1945.
Many artists left Germany during the Reich.
The book is about daily life in the Reich.
Historians still study the fall of the Reich.
note: Used mostly for Nazi Germany, as "the Third Reich."

meaning_hint: Also any game or question that tests your thinking (a crossword puzzle); a jigsaw is a 'jigsaw puzzle'.
examples: We spent the evening doing a big jigsaw puzzle.
One piece of the puzzle is missing.

note: In English "puzzle" also means any mystery; a picture one is a "jigsaw puzzle".

examples: Patriotism grew strong during the war.

meaning_hint: Both the state of matter and blood plasma.
examples: Lightning is a form of plasma.
The sun is made of hot plasma.
Plasma is the fourth state of matter.
Scientists study plasma in the lab.

meaning_hint: Only the noun (a romantic person, a Romantic artist); the adjective is романтичний.
examples: He is a romantic who loves old movies.
She is a romantic at heart.
Only a romantic would write poems like that.

meaning_hint: Usually collective (textiles, fabrics); a single fabric is тканина.
examples: The town is famous for its textiles.

The remake is better than the original movie.

"Cool" is common slang for "good".

meaning_hint: offensive insult in both languages
examples: He was bullied and called a retard at school.
Using the word retard is hurtful.

Calling someone a retard is a cruel insult.
note: Highly offensive slur; do not use it.

meaning_hint: More often written дао in Ukrainian.

Install the OS before adding programs.
A cyclone hit the island.
The cyclone destroyed many homes.
People left before the cyclone arrived.

meaning_hint: A march (soldiers, protest, music piece); the month March is березень.
examples: The soldiers went on a long march.
The march started at dawn.
The army band played a march.
The march lasted three days.

meaning_hint: The Greek letter Κ, κ.
examples: Kappa is the tenth letter of the Greek alphabet.

meaning_hint: Noun; the adjective is капіталістичний.
examples: He is a rich capitalist.
Capitalists invest money to make profit.

meaning_hint: Also a hybrid car.
examples: This tree is a hybrid of two species.
A mule is a hybrid of a horse and a donkey.
Farmers grow hybrids that resist disease.
The rose in our garden is a hybrid.

meaning_hint: Indeclinable in Ukrainian.
examples: The president used his veto on the new law.

meaning_hint: A rule or norm, a literary canon, a musical canon; a church official (canon) = канонік.
examples: The book is part of the biblical canon.

I love the decor in this restaurant.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian регент also = a church choir conductor.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian mostly a noun: handmade goods.
examples: She sells handmade jewelry online.

meaning_hint: Written lowercase in Ukrainian.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian the playing card (or a wild card); a person who jokes is жартівник.

examples: The boat's propeller got caught in some weeds.

meaning_hint: Also figurative: a sham.

meaning_hint: ізі is gamer/internet slang; the standard word is легко/легкий.

meaning_hint: The everyday Ukrainian word is ікра; кав'яр is rare.
